content.title: How AI-driven pricing inflates consumer costs: Consumer Reports
content.description:
Consumer Reports director of technology policy, Justin Brookman, sits down with Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre on Market Domination Overtime to discuss how artificial intelligence (AI)–driven pricing experiments have been creating variance and higher costs for groceries and other consumer goods. Some companies, like Instacart (CART), have stopped engaging in this practice.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.
